ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1 balance between high-intensity (white) and low-intensity (black) pixels across the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe consists of a large, high-intensity white contiguous region spanning approximately 80% of its area, bordered by low-intensity black mottling along the trailing edge. The right lobe is a nearly solid low-intensity black contiguous region with localized high-intensity spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated 2D interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations across the boundary; high-frequency jagged peaks visible on the distal left tip (amplitudes of 10-20 pixels) and lower-frequency peaks along the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a convex outer curve; the right lobe follows a shallow concave curve leading toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of thin, high-intensity diagonal and horizontal linear streaks crossing the dark pigmentation of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular barnacle attachment scars on the right lobe and irregular jagged tissue loss at the terminal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme bilateral pigmentation asymmetry divided by the median notch axis.
